resources.basis: Every one of 75070 NPZ matrices/ordered identities reconstructed, 15264 original geometry certificates and all 30 repaired input certificates checked; all 414720 setting links compared. Approximately 62.75 GB of inputs read plus before/after source hashes. Single CPU, active-time planning allowance, not ETA or timeout.

scope: Full resolved-registry independent serialized readback; no optimizer, subsampling or tolerance change. Full matrix/identity/certificate provenance rather than count-only confirmation.
